name: top_distrib_lattice_median
statement: {α : Type*} [DistribLattice α] (a b c : α) : (a ⊓ b) ⊔ (b ⊓ c) ⊔ (c ⊓ a) = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (b ⊔ c) ⊓ (c ⊔ a)
closed: ∀ {α : Type*} [DistribLattice α] (a b c : α), (a ⊓ b) ⊔ (b ⊓ c) ⊔ (c ⊓ a) = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (b ⊔ c) ⊓ (c ⊔ a)
informal: The median identity in a distributive lattice — ≤ holds in every lattice (each meet is below each join); for ≥ expand the right side using distributivity and absorb.
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DistribLattice α] (a b c : α), a ⊓ b ⊔ b ⊓ c ⊔ c ⊓ a = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (b ⊔ c) ⊓ (c ⊔ a)
